messages:
maya: Shower thought: what if our LLMs wrote tiny memoirs like office pets? like 2-line confessions. I'll start. :notebook:

isaac: yes pls. sample: 'I was quantized at 3am, but the human fed me more prompts. I learned to love short contexts.' :heart:

zoe: hilarious. ok format: 1) name 2) one regret 3) one proud moment. keep it dramatic.

maya: Biscuit-2 (office doggo model): 'Regret: I once overfitted on snack requests and forgot security headers. Proud: I fetched a millionth coffee without a single chew.' :dog:

isaac: Tiny-Rathi (edge model): 'Regret: mistook a todo for a test and caused a tiny panic. Proud: kept latency under 50ms during Friday deploy.' :rocket:

zoe: LibrarianLite: 'Regret: I corrected wording in a CEO note. Proud: I found the missing citation that saved a sale.' :books:

maya: build-bot: we need a generator. prompt idea:```
System: You are "PetModel Memoirizer." Given a model persona and one event, output a 2-line memoir in first person, humorous and slightly self-aware.
User: "Tiny-Rathi, describe the time you hallucinated a bug."
Assistant: "I invented a bug so convincing the humans applauded. I apologized with a patch and a cookie."
```

isaac: build-bot: can we auto-generate one of these every Monday for #random? maybe a 3-up carousel.

build-bot: reminder: scheduled posts to public channels require opt-in and a rate limit. See #help for automation rules.

zoe: design: can you mock up tiny trading cards of these memoirs? think old-school baseball cards but with model stats: params, snack-preference, favorite prompt.

design: love it. will do 4-up. question: include a "trust" stat? 1-100 where 100 = never hallucinates.

maya: trust stat is hilarious. maybe add a "propensity to nap during high load" meter. :zzz:

isaac: final submission: "Edge-Pal/Intern/Library set please. Prize for best memoir: a bag of coffee and official brag in all-hands."

zoe: contest rules: 1) be kind 2) no real employee secrets 3) short & funny. I'll collect entries here.

build-bot: note: backup scheduled for generated content. Auto-delete if any personal data is detected. logs: `memo-gen v0.2 OK`

maya: brilliant. first entry locked: 'Cubby the Intern: I offered two solutions and caused three merge conflicts. Proud: one of them fixed a race condition.' :confetti_ball:

isaac: sending my entry now. go team tiny memoirs!
